answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 150929 Country: Bangladesh Title: I want to read Homeopathic. According to Shariah whether it is lawful or wrong. Question: I want to read Homeopathic. According to Shariah whether it is lawful or wrong. Answer ID: 150929 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 876/785/B=8/1438) There is no harm in learning the lawful and halal sciences. Studying medicine whether it is homeopathic or allopathic is lawful if it is in line with Shariah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
